title: NVIDIA overlay black-screen kill (ref)
desc: T3 reference for nvidia-overlay-blackscreen-kill: dated WipeBlockingOverlays bug/detection fixes and the brightness-guard lesson.
steps: BUG FIX 2026-05-27: WipeBlockingOverlays sent WM_CLOSE to ALL large visible windows (>=75% screen) every 30s incl Edge/Chrome/VS Code. Fix: gate PostMessageW(WM_CLOSE) behind if(knownBlocker); non-blockers only hidden, not closed.

DETECTION FIX 2026-05-27: old detection was size-only (no topmost/z-order) so it false-positived maximized Edge. Root: the screensaver is TOPMOST so only a TOPMOST window can obscure it. Fix: non-knownBlocker requires WS_EX_TOPMOST AND >=50% screen; WM_CLOSE still gated to knownBlocker.

2026-06-12 movie-fold marathon: a brightness-only minimize/kill (SuppressFullscreenOpaqueOverlays) folded the user Edge -- reinforced the 'never act on brightness alone, gate on window class' rule now in T1.
author: claude
